title: Essay Type
description: A named essay form as an ordered composition of components, plus any organizational patterns unique to choosing between arrangements of that form.

purpose.description: What this essay type is for, crux-first — the reader need it answers, not a definition of its shape.

subtype_of.description: id of a broader essay type this specializes (e.g. compare-contrast is a subtype of expository).

components.description: Ordered top-to-bottom as they'd appear in the essay.

note.description: How this component's job narrows for this specific essay type, if it does.

organizational_patterns.description: Named alternative arrangements a writer chooses between for this type (e.g. block vs. point-by-point). Omit if the type has only one natural order.

pitfalls.description: Failure modes specific to this type, worth checking for directly.
